text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text:
'King Halo, having finished the
"first 3 years" that are so important to an Uma Musume'

text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text: “Our program followed her ‘present’ after she surprised the world with a sudden change of direction—”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. Today's time isn't bad either.

text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text: "—Is it... not bad?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, was the behind-the-scenes coverage starting today?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. And then?
Did you have any questions?

text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text:
“—To think that even with such a great time, it's not considered 'good,'
but merely 'not bad.'”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, so that's it.
Then let me tell you."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Great" is a word you use when you're completely satisfied, right?
That's why for now, it's just "not bad."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I am a first-class Umamusume.
I cannot be satisfied with just this.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I have a meeting with my Trainer now.
See you later.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Come on, Trainer! Quick march!
Let's exit in style! Just like we practiced!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't slouch!
Stand up straight! The cameras must still be following us!

text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text: "—And then, King Halo departed alongside her Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text:
“—The following day, I visited King Halo,
who was scheduled to run in a race.”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good day.
You certainly are working hard on your coverage today too.

text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text: "—Since it's an exclusive behind-the-scenes feature, after all."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Well then, as a special treat,
I'll give you the privilege of capturing it on that camera.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: My victory.

text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text: "—However, on that day, King Halo unfortunately failed to take first place."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...There is no need to be so afraid.
You want to interview me, do you not?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It may have turned out like this,
but that doesn't change the fact that this is who I am right now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the current situation is, I accept it gracefully.
Using everything as fuel, I will keep walking forward.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's what King is all about.

text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text: "—That's quite a strong resolve."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fufu, is that really the part you're surprised by?

text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text: "—Where does that fighting spirit come from, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder where from.
Though there is only one thing I can say for sure.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Whether my opponent is a genius
or a living legend, it doesn't matter to me."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep running my own path, true to myself.
Without hanging my head—just like a King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what path lies ahead,
I will show you in the end that I can smile as the victor."

text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text:
"—King Halo moves forward
without ever looking back."

text_block_list.name: Show Narration
text_block_list.text:
“—This is the back of a first-rate Umamusume,
who makes the 'Golden Generation' shine.”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why not!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That special feature was the absolute best! It was packed with King's charm like nothing else ever could be!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, did you hear that!?
A first-rate Umamusume who makes the Golden Generation shine!!"
choice_data_list: That's what they were saying, huh.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Right?♪ Hehe♪"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This footage is an absolute keeper!
Trainer, you must never delete it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SLIDE)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
King-chan, that's amaaaazing!!
When did they start doing a close-up documentary on you!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, what is this!?
Acting like the face of our generation while ignoring El--!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but that show was
so very King-chan, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. The way you scolded your Trainer back there felt so totally 'King' of you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not the point at all, is it?!
The best part of that show is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And just like that,
the room became lively in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, there was one more thing
on that show that made me happy, but—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...? What's wrong,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Mumbling under your breath like that.
If you have something to say, why not say it out loud?"
choice_data_list: That was a great show, wasn't it?
That was a great show, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...On that show, King Halo was being
interviewed as an individual Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not referred to as "someone's daughter,"
but as a "first-class Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed.
My talent was on full display.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That of the "first-class Umamusume, King Halo"♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And King Halo lets out a triumphant laugh,
just like always—true to who she is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —As expected of a first-class Umamusume.
